title: the glasshouse
caption: Warm in here, and wet. Everything is growing toward the door you came in by.

hotspots.label: The door back to the hall, ajar
The long planting beds
hotspots.text: The beds rise and fall together. After a moment you notice you have joined in.

hotspots.label: A bell jar on a low table
hotspots.text: It fogs from the inside, twice. Something in there is keeping warm.

hotspots.label: An old brass tap
hotspots.text: The tap drips. Upward. You watch three drops go and decide it is none of your business.

hotspots.label: An open vent in the roof, dark green beyond
hotspots.text: The vent stands open, but the green up there is packed too tight to pass. For now.
hotspots.hint: Up through the vent: the canopy floor — a landscape grown on top of the glasshouse roof, where the plants that left live now. The escaped collection, doing well. Verdigris on abyss, moonlit from much closer up.

hotspots.label: A pale fruit on the vine
hotspots.text: One fruit is the same pale colour as the thing in the wood, and the same shape. It is facing you.
